note: Validation-only prototype; the test split was not loaded. Minority classes are tiny, so per-class metrics are unstable. FEVER has no trusted evidence_accessibility samples (not computable). is_refutes_prediction is kept; it may act as a FEVER-specific shortcut.

stage1.selection_rule: failure_recall >= 0.7; max binary_macro_f1; within 0.01 prefer fewer false positives, then smaller C, then class_weight=None

stage2.selection_rule: max macro_f1 on validation true failures; within 0.01 prefer smaller C
